Name: Tileman Reworked
Author: RayRayElite
Description:
[center][b][size=6]Tileman Reworked[/size][/b]
[i]Every step has a price.[/i][/center]

[b]Tileman Reworked[/b] is a hardcore Stardew Valley challenge mod. Every tile in the world must be purchased before it can be walked on, built on, or used. Movement becomes a resource. Exploration becomes an investment. Every decision you make shapes which parts of the world you can access, and when.

Designed for veteran players, challenge runs, and streaming content.

[youtube]1hbxOxUc2-Y[/youtube]

[line]
[b][size=5]Overview[/size][/b]

You begin with only a small safe area around your bed. Everything else has to be unlocked one tile at a time. Every path, shortcut, and expansion costs something.

Your run becomes a constant tradeoff. Spend early to reach the mines. Save for tool upgrades. Push into town. Expand the farm. There is no single right route, and that is what makes the challenge work.

[b]What the mod adds:[/b]
[list]
[*]Works on all maps, including Stardew Valley Expanded and other custom locations[/*]
[*]Built-in difficulty profiles plus full custom settings[/*]
[*]Several pricing styles, bonus tile rewards, and optional rule changes[/*]
[*]A full in-game dashboard for stats, goals, updates, and quick config access[/*]
[*]Deep visual customization for overlays, fog, HUD placement, and colors[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[b][size=5]How It Plays[/size][/b]

[size=4][b]Tile Purchasing[/b][/size]
Buy tiles in whichever way fits your run:
[list]
[*][b]Tile Tool[/b] - Buy nearby tiles the classic way[/*]
[*][b]Cursor Mode[/b] - Click visible tiles directly on screen[/*]
[*][b]Collision[/b] - Walk into a locked tile to buy it on contact if you want faster play[/*]
[/list]Undo is supported, and refund rules are configurable.

[size=4][b]Bonus Tiles[/b][/size]
Free tiles come from normal progression, so the run keeps opening up even when gold is tight.
[list]
[*]Meeting villagers and building friendships[/*]
[*]Quest progress, tool upgrades, animals, and house upgrades[/*]
[*]Museum, collections, walnuts, legendary fish, and other long-term goals[/*]
[*]Major milestones like Community Center progress and late-game areas[/*]
[/list]You can spend bonus tiles as you earn them or save them up for a bigger push later.

[line]
[b][size=5]Difficulty And Progression[/size][/b]

[size=4][b]Difficulty Profiles[/b][/size]
The mod now includes ready-made profiles so you can get started quickly:
[list]
[*][b]Easy[/b] - More forgiving prices and progression[/*]
[*][b]Medium[/b] - A solid default challenge[/*]
[*][b]Hard[/b] - Tighter economy and more planning[/*]
[*][b]Pain[/b] - Built for rough runs and mistakes that hurt[/*]
[*][b]Custom[/b] - Tune everything yourself[/*]
[/list]Profiles adjust more than one number at a time, so they feel like actual presets instead of a single slider.

[size=4][b]Difficulty Types[/b][/size]
After picking a profile, you can also choose how tile prices grow:
[list]
[*][b]Classic[/b] - Prices rise steadily as you buy more tiles[/*]
[*][b]Tiered[/b] - Prices stay flat for a while, then jump at set milestones[/*]
[*][b]Tile Counter[/b] - Each tile costs the number of tiles you have already bought[/*]
[/list]

[line]
[b][size=5]Visual Settings[/size][/b]

The visual side of the mod is much more flexible now. You can keep it simple or make it very readable.

[list]
[*]Switch between Buy with Tool, Buy with Cursor, Unlocked Tiles, No Purchase, and No Overlay[/*]
[*]Use built-in overlay presets or make your own look[/*]
[*]Adjust colors, fill style, outlines, opacity, and winter colors separately[/*]
[*]Use fog of war to hide unbought land if you want a harsher run[/*]
[*]Turn on accessibility options like stronger outlines, outline-only tiles, and reduced animation[/*]
[*]Move the HUD where you want it with presets and fine adjustment[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[b][size=5]Tileman Dashboard[/size][/b]

The in-game dashboard opens from the inventory tab or its hotkey and gives you a clean place to check progress:
[list]
[*][b]Statistics[/b] - Tiles bought, money spent, current price, and world progress[/*]
[*][b]Goals[/b] - Bonus tile milestones, friendship progress, and long-term objectives[/*]
[*][b]Updates[/b] - Installed version, update status, changelog, and quick links to Nexus and Discord[/*]
[*][b]Config[/b] - Open GMCM directly from the dashboard[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[b][size=5]Gameplay Options[/size][/b]

Some optional rules you can turn on or off:
[list]
[*]Allow forage or furniture on unbought tiles[/*]
[*]Generate tiles under resource objects[/*]
[*]Start with the farmhouse unlocked[/*]
[*]Restrict the challenge to the farm only[/*]
[*]Require the Tile Tool for purchases[/*]
[*]Adjust undo rules, bonus tile rewards, keybinds, and more through GMCM[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[b][size=5]Multiplayer[/size][/b]

Multiplayer is supported. The host controls the shared rules, while tile progress, pricing, rewards, and world stats stay in sync across the farm.

[line]
[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]

Tileman Reworked is designed to work with:
[list]
[*]Vanilla Stardew Valley[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE) and other large map mods[/*]
[*]Custom locations and modded maps[/*]
[*]Split-screen multiplayer[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (strongly recommended)[/*]
[/list]
